verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a customer-retrieval endpoint keyed on a caller-supplied external identifier, which returns a 308 Permanent Redirect to the canonical customer record. That supports reconciling customer records with your own IDs. Nothing in the pack shows external identifiers on cases or alerts, or how stable the identifiers are. Missing for 10: external-identifier support for case records, documentation of identifier uniqueness and stability guarantees, and hands-on corroboration of the lookup flow.
